source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 7 (PDF 139-173), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Waves and Vibrations) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 A wave is a regular disturbance that carries:
(Wave (lehar) aik baqaida khalal (disturbance) hai jo kya cheez le kar chalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wave aik baqaida khalal hai jo energy (tawanai) le kar source se phailti hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: A wave is a regular disturbance or variation that carries energy

blocks.prompt:
2 When a stone is thrown into a pond, the water particles:
(Jab talaab mein pathar phenka jaye to paani ke zarraat (particles) kya karte hain?)

options.text: apni jagah oopar neeche harkat karte hain
ripple ke saath bahar chale jaate hain
sirf pathar ki taraf chalte hain

blocks.explanation: Paani ke zarraat apni hi jagah oopar neeche harkat karte hain aur aik dohrata pattern (wave) phailta hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: The water particles move up and down at their own places

blocks.prompt:
3 The displacement of a particle of a wave is its distance in a specified direction from its:
(Wave ke zarre ka displacement kis jagah se kisi khaas simt mein faasla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Displacement zarre ka apni rest / equilibrium (tawazun) position se kisi khaas simt mein faasla hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: The displacement of a particle of a wave is its distance in a specified direction

blocks.prompt:
4 In the waveform of Fig. 7.2, displacement is plotted on the y-axis and the x-axis shows:
(Fig. 7.2 ki waveform mein y-axis par displacement hai; x-axis kya dikhata hai?)

options.text: energy ke safar ki simt mein faasla

blocks.explanation: Waveform ka x-axis energy ke safar ki simt mein faasla (distance) hai, jaise Fig. 7.2 par likha hai (7.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: The x-axis of this waveform is the distance in the direction of energy travel

blocks.prompt:
5 The maximum displacement of the particles of the medium from the equilibrium position is called:
(Medium ke zarraat ka equilibrium position se zyada se zyada displacement kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude (A) equilibrium position se wave ya zarraat ka zyada se zyada displacement hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Amplitude (A): The maximum displacement of the wave

blocks.prompt:
6 The distance between two consecutive similar points on a wave that are in phase is the:
(Wave par do lagataar milte julte points jo aik hi phase mein hon, un ka darmiyani faasla kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wavelength (λ) wave par do lagataar milte julte, aik phase wale points ka faasla hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Wavelength (λ): The distance between two consecutive similar points

blocks.prompt:
7 The number of oscillations or cycles per second of a wave is its:
(Wave ke aik second mein oscillations (jhoolon) ya cycles ki tadaad kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Frequency (f) aik second mein oscillations ya cycles ki tadaad hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: The number of oscillations/vibrations or cycles per second.

blocks.prompt:
8 A wave has a frequency of 250 Hz. Its period is:
(Aik wave ki frequency 250 Hz hai. Us ka period (waqfa) kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: T = 1/f = 1/250 = 0.004 s; period frequency ka ulat (reciprocal) hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: it is the reciprocal of the frequency T = 1/f

blocks.prompt:
9 In obtaining v = fλ from v = λ/T, the step used is:
(v = λ/T se v = fλ hasil karte waqt kaun sa qadam istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Speed = faasla/waqt = λ/T; chunke 1/T = f, is liye v = fλ (Eq. 7.1).

book_ref.quote: If a wave crest moves one wavelength λ in one period of oscillation T

blocks.prompt:
10 A sound wave of frequency 500 Hz has a wavelength of 0.68 m. Its speed is:
(500 Hz frequency wali sound wave ki wavelength 0.68 m hai. Us ki speed kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: 5. Speed (v): The speed at which the wave travels.

blocks.prompt:
11 The relative position of a point on the wave at a given time is called its:
(Kisi diye gaye waqt par wave par kisi point ki nisbati position kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phase (θ) kisi waqt par wave par point ki nisbati (relative) position hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: 6. Phase (θ): The relative position of a point on the wave at a given time.

blocks.prompt:
12 In a transverse wave, the particles of the medium vibrate:
(Transverse wave mein medium ke zarraat kis tarah vibrate karte hain?)

options.text: energy ke safar ki simt ke saath saath
sirf energy ki simt ke ulat
energy ke safar ki simt ke amoodi (90°)

blocks.explanation: Transverse wave mein zarraat ki vibration energy ke safar ki simt ke amoodi (90°) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A transverse wave is one in which the vibrations of the particles are at right angle

blocks.prompt:
13 A wave in which the particles vibrate along (parallel to) the direction of energy travel is a:
(Woh wave jis mein zarraat energy ke safar ki simt ke mutawazi (saath saath) vibrate karein, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Longitudinal wave mein zarraat ki vibration energy ke safar ki simt ke saath (mutawazi) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: the direction of the vibration of the particles is along or parallel to

blocks.prompt:
14 Waves that require a physical medium (solid, liquid or gas) to propagate are:
(Woh waves jinhein phailne ke liye maaddi medium (solid, liquid ya gas) chahiye, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mechanical waves ko maaddi medium chahiye; misalein: paani ki waves, sound waves, seismic (zalzale ki) waves.

book_ref.quote: These waves require a physical medium (solid, liquid, or gas) to propagate.

blocks.prompt:
15 Which of the following can travel through vacuum?
(In mein se kaun si wave khala (vacuum) mein safar kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: X-rays electromagnetic waves hain jinhein medium nahi chahiye, is liye vacuum mein chal sakti hain; baaqi mechanical hain.

book_ref.quote: They do not require a medium to propagate and therefore, can travel through vacuum.

blocks.prompt:
16 Electron waves in atoms (de-Broglie waves) are an example of:
(Atoms mein electron waves (de-Broglie waves) kis qisam ki waves ki misaal hain?)
blocks.explanation: Quantum waves electrons aur photons jaise zarraat se wabasta hain, maslan matter waves ya de-Broglie waves.

book_ref.quote: Quantum waves are associated with particles like electrons and photons.

blocks.prompt:
17 Waves that propagate along the interface between two mediums are called:
(Do mediums ki sarhad (interface) ke saath chalne wali waves kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Surface waves do mediums ki sath ya sarhad ke saath chalti hain, maslan hawa se banne wali samandar ki sath ki waves.

book_ref.quote: Surface waves propagate along surfaces or interfaces between two mediums.

blocks.prompt:
18 The energy of the Sun reaches the Earth through empty space because light waves are:
(Sooraj ki energy khaali jagah se guzar kar Zameen tak pohanchti hai kyunke light waves:)

options.text: mechanical waves hain jinhein hawa chahiye
electromagnetic waves hain jo vacuum mein chal sakti hain

blocks.explanation: Sooraj se Zameen tak energy light waves se aati hai jo electromagnetic waves hain aur vacuum mein chal sakti hain (7.1).

book_ref.quote: The vast energy of the Sun, millions kilometres away, is transferred to the Earth by light waves.

blocks.prompt:
19 When two waves overlap, their individual displacements are added together to form:
(Jab do waves aapas mein milti hain to un ke alag displacements jama ho kar kya banate hain?)

options.text: do alag waves jo aik doosre par asar nahi karteen

blocks.explanation: Alag displacements ka algebraic majmua aik naya wave pattern banata hai (7.2, Fig. 7.4).

book_ref.quote: then the resultant displacement of the particle is the algebraic sum of their individual displacements

blocks.prompt:
20 Two overlapping waves of displacements 3 cm and 3 cm are in the same phase. The resultant displacement is:
(3 cm aur 3 cm displacement wali do waves aik hi phase mein mil rahi hain. Resultant displacement kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik phase mein y = y₁ + y₂; y₁ = y₂ ho to y = 2y₁ = 6 cm (7.2).

book_ref.quote: (i) If two waves, which overlap each other, have same phase

blocks.prompt:
21 Two waves of displacements 5 mm and 2 mm cross each other in opposite phase. The resultant displacement is:
(5 mm aur 2 mm displacement wali do waves ulat phase mein aik doosre ko cross karti hain. Resultant displacement kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ulat phase mein y = y₁ − y₂ = 5 − 2 = 3 mm (7.2).

book_ref.quote: (ii) If two waves, which cross each other, have opposite phase

blocks.prompt:
22 Two identical waves of equal displacement meet in opposite phase. The resultant displacement is:
(Barabar displacement wali do aik jaisi waves ulat phase mein milti hain. Resultant displacement kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Ulat phase mein y = y₁ − y₂; agar y₁ = y₂ to y = 0 (7.2).

book_ref.quote: Particularly, if y₁ = y₂, then resultant displacement will be y = 0.

blocks.prompt:
23 Three waves produce displacements of +4 mm, +3 mm and −5 mm at a particle at the same instant. The resultant displacement is:
(Teen waves aik hi lamhe aik zarre par +4 mm, +3 mm aur −5 mm displacement paida karti hain. Resultant displacement kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: y = 4 + 3 + (−5) = +2 mm; displacements algebraic tor par jama hote hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: the resultant displacement y of the particle, under the simultaneous action of these n waves

blocks.prompt:
24 In y(x,t) = y₁(x,t) + y₂(x,t) + … + yₙ(x,t), the function y(x,t) represents the:
(y(x,t) = y₁(x,t) + y₂(x,t) + … + yₙ(x,t) mein y(x,t) kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: point x aur waqt t par resultant displacement
waqt t par wave ki speed

blocks.explanation: y(x,t) point x aur waqt t par resultant wave displacement hai; yeh wave ki shakal aur waqt ke saath tabdeeli batata hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: It describes the shape of the wave and its evolution over time.

blocks.prompt:
25 The principle of superposition applies to:
(Superposition ka usool kin waves par laagu hota hai?)

options.text: linear waves, yani chhote amplitude wali waves
sirf bohat bare amplitude wali waves

blocks.explanation: Superposition ka usool linear waves, yani chhote amplitude wali waves par laagu hota hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: The principle of superposition applies to linear waves or small

blocks.prompt:
26 Superposition of two waves of slightly different frequencies travelling in the same direction gives:
(Thori mukhtalif frequencies wali do waves jo aik hi simt mein chalein, un ke superposition se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thori mukhtalif frequencies wali, aik simt mein chalti do waves se beats bante hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: Two waves of slightly different frequencies and travelling in the same direction (Beats).

blocks.prompt:
27 Two waves of equal frequency travelling in opposite directions superpose to produce:
(Barabar frequency wali do waves ulat simton mein chalein to superposition se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Barabar frequency, ulat simt wali do waves se stationary (thehri hui) waves banti hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: Two waves of equal frequency travelling in opposite direction (Stationary waves).

blocks.prompt:
28 In noise-cancelling headphones, the processing unit generates an anti-noise signal which is:
(Noise-cancelling headphones mein processing unit aik anti-noise signal banata hai jo:)

options.text: shor ke saath aik hi phase mein
amplitude aur phase mein shor ka bilkul ulat
shor se bohat zyada frequency wala

blocks.explanation: Anti-noise signal amplitude aur phase mein maahol ke shor ka bilkul ulat hota hai, is liye superposition se dono khatam ho jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: which is the exact opposite of the ambient noise (in terms of amplitude and phase)

blocks.prompt:
29 In noise-cancelling headphones, the ambient noise is first captured by:
(Noise-cancelling headphones mein maahol ka shor sab se pehle kis cheez se pakra jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Headphones mein aik ya zyada microphones maahol ka shor pakarte hain; phir signal amplifier aur processing unit ko jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The headphones contain one or more microphones that capture ambient noise

blocks.prompt:
30 Superposition of two waves of the same frequency travelling in the same direction is called:
(Aik hi frequency wali do waves jo aik hi simt mein chalein, un ka superposition kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik frequency, aik simt wali do waves ka superposition interference (mudakhilat) kehlata hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: Superposition of two waves having the same frequency and travelling in the same direction

blocks.prompt:
31 In the interference experiment, the two loudspeakers vibrate in phase because they:
(Interference ke tajurbe mein dono loudspeakers aik phase mein kyun vibrate karte hain?)

options.text: aik hi audio generator se chalaye jaate hain

blocks.explanation: Dono speakers aik hi Audio Generator se chalte hain, is liye aik phase mein vibrate karte hain; aise sources coherent hain (7.3).

book_ref.quote: Since the two speakers are driven from the same generator, therefore, they vibrate in phase.

blocks.prompt:
32 In the interference experiment for sound, the CRO is used to:
(Sound ke interference tajurbe mein CRO kis kaam aata hai?)

options.text: input signal ko waveform ki shakal mein dikhana
speakers ko aik phase mein rakhna

blocks.explanation: CRO microphone ke input signal ko apni screen par waveform ki shakal mein dikhata hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: The CRO is a device to display the input signal into waveform on its screen.

blocks.prompt:
33 At a point of constructive interference of two sound waves:
(Do sound waves ke constructive interference wale point par kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: P₁, P₃, P₅ par compression compression se aur rarefaction rarefaction se milta hai, is liye bara displacement (7.3).

book_ref.quote: a compression meets a compression and a rarefaction meets a rarefaction

blocks.prompt:
34 The condition for constructive interference is that the path difference ΔS equals:
(Constructive interference ki shart yeh hai ke path difference ΔS barabar ho:)
blocks.explanation: Jab path difference wavelength ka poora (integral) multiple ho, ΔS = nλ, to waves jama ho jaati hain (7.3).

book_ref.quote: Whenever the path difference is an integral multiple of wavelength

blocks.prompt:
35 For destructive interference, the path difference must be:
(Destructive interference ke liye path difference kya hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Khatam hone wale points par path difference λ/2 ka taaq (odd) multiple hota hai: ΔS = (2n + 1)λ/2 (7.3).

book_ref.quote: the path difference is an odd integral multiple of half the wavelength

blocks.prompt:
36 Two coherent sources of wavelength 0.40 m give a path difference of 1.0 m at a point. At that point there is:
(0.40 m wavelength wale do coherent sources se aik point par path difference 1.0 m hai. Us point par kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: 1.0 m = 2.5 λ = (2×2 + 1)λ/2, yani λ/2 ka odd multiple, is liye destructive interference (7.3).

book_ref.quote: At points P₂ and P₄, a compression meets a rarefaction

blocks.prompt:
37 Two coherent sources emit sound of wavelength 0.25 m. At a point the path difference is 0.75 m. The result there is:
(Do coherent sources 0.25 m wavelength ki sound dete hain. Aik point par path difference 0.75 m hai. Wahan kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: 0.75 m = 3λ, yani λ ka poora multiple, is liye constructive interference (7.3).

book_ref.quote: Similarly, at points P₃ and P₅, path difference is zero and −λ, respectively.

blocks.prompt:
38 Two speakers 0.90 m apart emit the same tone of 1100 Hz. A microphone 1.20 m in front of one speaker (opposite it) is at the first point of maximum loudness beside the centre. The speed of sound is:
(0.90 m door do speakers 1100 Hz ki aik hi tone dete hain. Aik speaker ke saamne 1.20 m par microphone, markaz ke baad pehle zyada aawaz wale point par hai. Sound ki speed kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Distance between speakers S₁S₂ = 3.0 m Tone frequency f = 344 Hz

blocks.prompt:
39 A radio transmitter works at 1.5 MHz. Radio waves travel at 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. The wavelength is:
(Aik radio transmitter 1.5 MHz par kaam karta hai. Radio waves 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ se chalti hain. Wavelength kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: λ = v/f = 3.0 × 10⁸ / 1.5 × 10⁶ = 200 m (v = fλ, Example 7.2 ki tarah).

book_ref.quote: Since, the speed of both the signals is same

blocks.prompt:
40 Sodium chloride in a flame gives out:
(Shola (flame) mein sodium chloride kaisi roshni deta hai?)

options.text: laal aur hari roshni ka mixture

blocks.explanation: Box ke mutabiq flame mein sodium chloride khalis peeli (monochromatic) roshni deta hai, laal aur hare ka mixture nahi.

book_ref.quote: Monochromatic Light Sodium chloride in a flame gives out pure yellow light.

blocks.prompt:
41 Stationary waves are formed by the superposition of two waves having:
(Stationary waves kin do waves ke superposition se banti hain?)

options.text: aik frequency aur amplitude, ulat simton mein
aik frequency, aik hi simt mein

blocks.explanation: Stationary waves aik frequency aur amplitude wali do waves se banti hain jo ulat simton mein chalein (7.4).

book_ref.quote: They are formed by the superposition of two waves with the same frequency and amplitude, travelling in opposite directions.

blocks.prompt:
42 In a stationary wave, the positions of the nodes and antinodes:
(Stationary wave mein nodes aur antinodes ki jagahein:)

options.text: wave speed se aage barhti hain
wave speed se peeche jaati hain

blocks.explanation: Pattern thehra rehta hai; nodes (sifr amplitude) aur antinodes (zyada amplitude) apni jagah qaim rehte hain (7.4).

book_ref.quote: with nodes (points of zero amplitude) and antinodes (points of maximum amplitude) at fixed positions

blocks.prompt:
43 A stationary wave has a wavelength of 0.80 m. The distance between two consecutive nodes is:
(Stationary wave ki wavelength 0.80 m hai. Do lagataar nodes ka faasla kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lagataar nodes ka faasla = λ/2 = 0.40 m (7.4).

book_ref.quote: Here, the distance between two consecutive nodes is λ/2.

blocks.prompt:
44 For a stationary wave of wavelength 0.80 m, the distance between a node and the next antinode is:
(0.80 m wavelength wali stationary wave mein node aur agle antinode ka faasla kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Node se agle antinode tak = λ/4 = 0.20 m (7.4).

book_ref.quote: The distance between a node and the next antinode is λ/4.

blocks.prompt:
45 Two waves, each of amplitude 2 cm, form a stationary wave. The amplitude at an antinode is:
(2 cm amplitude wali do waves stationary wave banati hain. Antinode par amplitude kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antinodes ka amplitude dono waves ke amplitudes ka majmua hai: 2 + 2 = 4 cm (7.4).

book_ref.quote: these points are moving with an amplitude which is the sum of the amplitudes of the component waves

blocks.prompt:
46 In a stationary wave, energy does not flow along the medium because:
(Stationary wave mein energy medium ke saath aage kyun nahi barhti?)
blocks.explanation: Nodes hamesha saakin rehte hain, is liye energy un se aage nahi guzarti; nodes ke darmiyan 'khari' rehti hai (7.4).

book_ref.quote: The nodes always remain at rest, so energy cannot flow past these points.

blocks.prompt:
47 When all antinodes of a stationary wave are at their extreme displacements, the energy is:
(Jab stationary wave ke tamam antinodes apne intehai displacement par hon to energy kis shakal mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Intehai displacement par energy poori potential hoti hai; equilibrium se guzarte waqt poori kinetic (7.4).

book_ref.quote: When the antinodes are all at their extreme displacements, the energy stored is wholly potential

blocks.prompt:
48 Which is an example of a stationary wave given in the chapter?
(Chapter mein di gayi stationary wave ki misaal kaun si hai?)

options.text: Chalti train ke horn ki aawaz

blocks.explanation: Stationary waves ki misalein: string par waves aur pipe mein sound waves (7.4).

book_ref.quote: The term "standing wave" describes that the wave pattern remains fixed in space

blocks.text: 7.5 Stationary waves on a stretched string

blocks.prompt:
49 A string clamped at both ends is plucked at its middle point. It vibrates with:
(Dono siron se kasi hui string ko beech se chheda (pluck) jaye to woh kaise vibrate karti hai?)

options.text: dono siron par antinodes aur beech mein aik node
dono siron par nodes aur beech mein aik antinode (aik loop)
teen nodes ke saath do loops

blocks.explanation: Kase hue sire nodes hain aur beech mein aik antinode; string aik loop mein vibrate karti nazar aati hai (7.5 a).

book_ref.quote: So, nodes will be formed at the two ends and one mode of vibration

blocks.prompt:
50 In the first mode of vibration of a string of length l, the wavelength is:
(Lambai l wali string ke pehle mode mein wavelength kitni hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do lagataar nodes ka faasla λ/2 hai, is liye l = λ₁/2, yani λ₁ = 2l (Eq. 7.2).

book_ref.quote: so in this mode of vibration, the length l of the string is

blocks.prompt:
51 The speed of waves on a stretched string depends upon:
(Kasi hui string par waves ki speed kin cheezon par munhasir hai?)

options.text: string ki tension aur fi unit lambai mass

blocks.explanation: v = √(F/m) tension F aur fi unit lambai mass m par munhasir hai; pluck karne ki jagah se aazad hai (Eq. 7.3).

book_ref.quote: It is independent of the point from where string is plucked to generate wave.

blocks.prompt:
52 A string has a tension of 100 N and mass per unit length 0.04 kg m⁻¹. The speed of transverse waves on it is:
(Aik string ki tension 100 N aur fi unit lambai mass 0.04 kg m⁻¹ hai. Us par transverse waves ki speed kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The speed v of the waves in the string depends upon the tension F

blocks.prompt:
53 A string 0.50 m long carries waves at 50 m s⁻¹ and vibrates in one loop. Its frequency is:
(0.50 m lambi string par waves 50 m s⁻¹ se chalti hain aur string aik loop mein vibrate karti hai. Frequency kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Knowing the speed v and wavelength λ₁, the frequency f₁ of the waves is

blocks.prompt:
54 If the tension in a string is made four times while its length and mass per unit length stay the same, its fundamental frequency:
(Agar string ki tension chaar guna kar di jaye aur lambai aur fi unit lambai mass wahi rahein to fundamental frequency:)
blocks.explanation: f₁ = (1/2l)√(F/m); f₁ ∝ √F, is liye chaar guna tension se frequency √4 = 2 guna (Eq. 7.4).

book_ref.quote: Thus, in the first mode of vibration shown in Fig. 7.7 (a)

blocks.prompt:
55 When the same string is plucked at one quarter of its length, it vibrates in:
(Jab wahi string apni lambai ke chauthai (quarter) hisse se chheri jaye to woh kitne loops mein vibrate karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quarter lambai se chherne par (jo antinode ki jagah hai) string do loops mein vibrate karti hai (7.5 b).

book_ref.quote: Note that now the string vibrates in two loops.

blocks.prompt:
56 In the second mode of vibration of a stretched string of length l:
(Lambai l wali kasi string ke doosre mode mein:)
blocks.explanation: Do loops se l = λ₂ aur f₂ = v/l = 2(v/2l) = 2f₁ (7.5 b).

book_ref.quote: so the length l of string is equal to the wavelength of the waves set up in this mode

blocks.prompt:
57 A string vibrating in 4 loops has:
(4 loops mein vibrate karti string mein kitne nodes aur antinodes hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: n loops mein (n + 1) nodes aur n antinodes: 5 nodes aur 4 antinodes (7.5 c).

book_ref.quote: Let the string resonates in n number of loops with (n + 1) nodes and n antinodes.

blocks.prompt:
58 A string 0.90 m long, fixed at both ends, vibrates in 3 loops. The wavelength is:
(Dono siron se bandhi 0.90 m lambi string 3 loops mein vibrate karti hai. Wavelength kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: and the corresponding wavelength is,

blocks.prompt:
59 As a stretched string vibrates in more loops, its frequency increases and its wavelength decreases, while:
(Jab kasi string zyada loops mein vibrate kare to frequency barhti aur wavelength ghatti hai, jab ke:)

options.text: un ka hasil-e-zarb fλ wave speed v ke barabar rehta hai

blocks.explanation: Frequency aur wavelength ka hasil-e-zarb hamesha wave ki speed v ke barabar rehta hai (7.5 c).

book_ref.quote: However, the product of the frequency f and wavelength λ is always equal to v

blocks.prompt:
60 The existence of only a discrete set of frequencies fₙ = nf₁ on a string is called:
(String par sirf alag alag frequencies fₙ = nf₁ ka hona kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Resonance frequencies ke darmiyan chhalang (quantum jump) ko frequencies ki quantization kehte hain (7.5 c).

book_ref.quote: This phenomenon is known as the Quantization of Frequencies.

blocks.prompt:
61 On a stretched string, waves whose frequencies are not in the harmonic series:
(Kasi string par woh waves jin ki frequencies harmonic series mein na hon:)

options.text: hamesha ke liye extra nodes banati hain

blocks.explanation: Stationary waves sirf harmonic series ki frequencies se banti hain; baaqi jaldi khatam (damp) ho jaati hain (7.5 c).

book_ref.quote: Waves which are not in harmonic series are quickly damped out.

blocks.prompt:
62 Once a guitar is tuned, the musician changes the frequency of a string by:
(Guitar tune hone ke baad musician string ki frequency kaise badalta hai?)

options.text: neck par ungliyan chala kar thirakne wali lambai badal kar
hawa mein sound ki speed badal kar

blocks.explanation: Pegs se tension badalti hai; tune hone ke baad ungliyan neck par chala kar thirakne wale hisse ki lambai badli jati hai (7.5 c).

book_ref.quote: the tension in guitar and violin strings is varied by tightening the pegs
